items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was just talking with somebody. I was talking to Joe Bowie about that.

ctx.x: The thing that really surprised me was when Sam Rivers was with him for a while.

I was just talking with somebody. I was talking to Joe Bowie about that. Sam was with Miles for a second. Actually, I thought that that would be nice, a nice change from – because, you know, Miles had trouble finding another saxophone player after Coltrane. He didn’t like Wayne Shorter in the beginning. Coltrane kept trying to get him the gig, Wayne, but he didn’t like Wayne in the beginning, and he didn’t like hardly anybody.
